mapper.insert: insert into lib_faq ( faq_id, userid, title, cnt ) values ( #{faqId}, #{userid}, #{title}, #{cnt} )
mapper.select: select q.faq_id, userid, title, cnt, write_date, COALESCE( json_agg(f.faq_file_ori_name) FILTER (WHERE f.faq_file_ori_name IS NOT NULL), '[]' ) AS file_ori_names, COALESCE( json_agg(f.faq_file_name) FILTER (WHERE f.faq_file_ori_name IS NOT NULL), '[]' ) AS file_names from lib_faq q LEFT JOIN lib_file_faq f ON q.faq_id = f.faq_id where (title like concat('%', #{sKey}, '%') or cnt like concat('%', #{sKey}, '%')) GROUP BY q.faq_id, userid, title, cnt, write_date order by q.faq_id desc limit #{recordCountPerPage} offset #{firstIndex}
select count(*) from lib_faq f where (title like concat('%', #{sKey}, '%') or cnt like concat('%', #{sKey}, '%'))
mapper.insert: insert into lib_file_faq ( faq_id, faq_file_name, faq_file_ori_name, faq_file_path ) values ( #{faqId}, #{faqFileName}, #{faqFileOriName}, #{faqFilePath} )
